description:
The plot illustrates the relative change in percentage across different layers for various configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from Layer-4 to Layer-32, with tick labels at Layer-4, Layer-5-12, Layer-13-20, Layer-21-28, and Layer-29-32. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and has a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, with tick labels at -15%, -10%, -5%, 0%, and 5%. 

A yellow line, labeled “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”, is represented with circular markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately 1.5% at Layer-4, declines to approximately -11% at Layer-13-20, and then rises to approximately -1.5% at Layer-32. An orange line, labeled “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”, is represented with square markers and a solid line style; it starts at approximately 1.5% at Layer-4, declines to approximately -13% at Layer-21-28, and then rises to approximately -3% at Layer-32. A blue line, labeled “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”, is represented with diamond markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately 1.5% at Layer-4, declines to approximately -14% at Layer-21-28, and then rises to approximately -4% at Layer-32. A gray dashed line, labeled “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit”, remains relatively constant at approximately 1.5% across all layers.
